english.note: This is the all-purpose choice for food eaten between meals, especially packaged or small snack foods.
Use this as the all-purpose word for a snack or sweet treat, but not specifically one made for pets.

examples.english: I usually have a snack in the afternoon.
examples.traditional: 我平時下晝會食啲零食。
examples.jyutping: ngo5 ping4 si4 haa6 zau3 wui5 sik6 di1 ling4 sik6

examples.english: I put a treat in your bag.
examples.traditional: 我放咗包零食喺你個袋入面。
examples.jyutping: ngo5 fong3 zo2 baau1 ling4 sik6 hai2 nei5 go3 doi6 jap6 min6
